blocks.en: Verification of Compendial Procedures: Complete Tutorial Edition

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 清楚區分「確效（Validation）」與「驗證（Verification）」的根本差異與法規要求
blocks.en: Clearly distinguish validation from verification, including the fundamental differences and the regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 理解21 CFR 211.194(a)(2)對藥廠使用USP方法的具體要求
blocks.en: Understand what 21 CFR 211.194(a)(2) specifically requires of manufacturers using USP methods

blocks.zh: 掌握驗證過程（Verification Process）的評估原則與範疇
blocks.en: Master the principles and scope for evaluating the verification process

blocks.zh: 理解驗證需求（Verification Requirements）的影響因素：程序複雜度、基質影響
blocks.en: Understand the factors that influence verification requirements: procedure complexity and matrix effects

blocks.zh: 識別哪些基礎藥典試驗不需要驗證，哪些需要
blocks.en: Identify which basic compendial tests do not need verification and which do

blocks.zh: 了解驗證失敗後的處理路徑：替代方法開發與提交USP
blocks.en: Understand the path to follow when verification fails: developing an alternative procedure and submitting it to USP

blocks.en: Introduction & Scope

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把USP藥典方法想像成一輛「通過國家安全認證的汽車」：確效（Validation）是汽車製造商在出廠前做的完整安全測試（碰撞測試、煞車性能、排放測試）；驗證（Verification）是你買回來後，在你家的車道、你常跑的路況上開個幾趟，確認這輛車在你的使用場景下表現正常。你不需要重複工廠的全套碰撞測試，但要確認它在你的條件下能正常運作。
blocks.en: Think of a USP method as a car that has passed national safety certification. Validation is the full set of safety tests the manufacturer runs before the car leaves the factory (crash tests, braking performance, emissions tests). Verification is what you do after buying the car: you drive it a few times on your own driveway and the roads you normally use, to confirm it performs properly in your situation. You do not need to repeat the factory's full crash testing, but you do need to confirm it works properly under your conditions.

blocks.zh: 微生物方法的例外 Microbiological Procedures Exception
blocks.en: Exception for Microbiological Procedures

blocks.zh: 本章明確排除微生物方法的驗證，這些由各自的藥典章節規定：
blocks.en: This chapter explicitly excludes verification of microbiological procedures, which are governed by their own compendial chapters:

blocks.zh: <51>：抗菌效力試驗
blocks.en: <51>: Antimicrobial Effectiveness Testing

blocks.zh: <61>：微生物計數試驗
blocks.en: <61>: Microbial Enumeration Tests

blocks.zh: <62>：特定微生物試驗
blocks.en: <62>: Tests for Specified Microorganisms

blocks.zh: <71>：無菌試驗
blocks.en: <71>: Sterility Tests

blocks.zh: <1227>：藥典品項微生物回收率驗證
blocks.en: <1227>: Validation of Microbial Recovery from Pharmacopeial Articles

blocks.zh: 這些方法的「適用性確認」叫做「方法適用性試驗（Method Suitability Test）」，不是本章的驗證。
blocks.en: The confirmation of suitability for these methods is called the "Method Suitability Test" and is not the verification described in this chapter.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家製藥公司首次使用USP <281> 重金屬限量試驗於新原料藥，需要做確效還是驗證？依據哪個法規條款？
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical company is using the USP <281> heavy metals limit test for the first time on a new drug substance. Is validation or verification required, and under which regulatory provision?

blocks.zh: <1226> 明確不適用於哪兩種情況？（提示：回顧性應用和微生物方法）
blocks.en: In which two situations does <1226> explicitly not apply? (Hint: retrospective application and microbiological procedures)

blocks.zh: Verification Process 驗證過程
blocks.en: Verification Process

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 驗證過程的三個核心問題：
blocks.en: The three core questions of the verification process:

blocks.zh: 問題一：方法能否用於預期目的？ — 在我的產品基質和我的實驗室條件下，方法結果是否可靠？
blocks.en: Question 1: Is the procedure suitable for its intended purpose? - Are the results reliable in my product matrix and under my laboratory conditions?

blocks.zh: 問題二：操作人員是否具備能力？ — 分析師必須有適當的培訓和經驗
blocks.en: Question 2: Are the operators competent? - Analysts must have appropriate training and experience

blocks.zh: 問題三：驗證失敗怎麼辦？ — 先尋求USP協助 → 若仍無法解決 → 開發替代方法 → 可提交USP修訂
blocks.en: Question 3: What if verification fails? - First seek assistance from USP; if the problem remains, develop an alternative procedure; the alternative can then be submitted to USP for a proposed revision

blocks.zh: 驗證失敗的處理路徑比喻 Failed Verification Pathway
blocks.en: Analogy: Failed Verification Pathway

blocks.zh: 驗證失敗就像發現「政府推薦的食譜」在你的廚房裡做不出來：先找食譜的原作者（USP）協助排疑；如果問題在於你的食材（基質干擾）確實讓這個食譜無法使用，你有權開發自己的食譜（替代方法）；如果你的新食譜更好，還可以投稿給政府更新食譜庫（提交USP）。
blocks.en: A failed verification is like finding that a "government-recommended recipe" does not work in your kitchen. First you ask the recipe's author (USP) for help troubleshooting. If your ingredients (matrix interference) truly make the recipe unusable, you have the right to develop your own recipe (an alternative procedure). And if your new recipe is better, you can also submit it to the government to update the recipe collection (submission to USP).

blocks.zh: 「替代方法」的法規路徑 Alternative Method Regulatory Pathway
blocks.en: Regulatory Pathway for an Alternative Procedure

blocks.zh: 依USP General Notices 6.30：
blocks.en: Per USP General Notices 6.30:

blocks.zh: 藥廠可以使用替代方法，但必須能證明等效性
blocks.en: A manufacturer may use an alternative procedure, but must be able to demonstrate equivalence

blocks.zh: 若替代方法可以取代藥典方法，可向USP提交建議修訂
blocks.en: If the alternative procedure can replace the compendial procedure, a proposed revision can be submitted to USP

blocks.zh: 對FDA審查而言：替代方法需要在申請文件中申報，並提供驗證資料支持等效性
blocks.en: For FDA review: the alternative procedure must be declared in the application, with verification data supporting equivalence

blocks.zh: USP HPLC含量測定方法，在使用某賦形劑複雜製劑時出現基質干擾，導致驗證失敗，依<1226>應採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: A USP HPLC assay shows matrix interference with a complex formulation containing a particular excipient, and verification fails. What steps should be taken under <1226>?

blocks.zh: 「操作人員具備適當培訓」這個要求，在驗證計畫中應如何體現？（如：需要記錄什麼？）
blocks.en: How should the requirement that "operators have appropriate training" be reflected in the verification plan? (For example, what needs to be documented?)

blocks.zh: Verification Requirements 驗證需求
blocks.en: Verification Requirements

blocks.zh: 驗證需求的決策框架 Verification Decision Framework
blocks.en: Verification Decision Framework

blocks.zh: 影響驗證範疇的關鍵因素：
blocks.en: Key factors affecting the scope of verification:

blocks.zh: 程序複雜度：HPLC含量測定 > 滴定法 > 燒失法；複雜的程序需要更全面的驗證
blocks.en: Procedure complexity: HPLC assay > titration > loss on ignition; more complex procedures require more comprehensive verification

blocks.zh: 基質複雜度：多成分製劑 > 單一成分原料藥；賦形劑可能干擾
blocks.en: Matrix complexity: multi-component formulation > single-component drug substance; excipients may interfere

blocks.zh: 使用者經驗：熟練分析師 + 常規方法 → 簡化驗證；新分析師 + 複雜方法 → 更完整評估
blocks.en: User experience: experienced analyst + routine procedure → simplified verification; new analyst + complex procedure → more complete evaluation

blocks.zh: 儀器類型：HPLC/LCMS等需要更多評估；pH計相對簡單
blocks.en: Instrument type: HPLC, LC-MS and similar instruments need more evaluation; a pH meter is relatively simple

blocks.zh: 特異性驗證的重要性比喻 Specificity as Priority
blocks.en: Analogy: Specificity as Priority

blocks.zh: 章節中以特異性為例，強調其重要性：USP方法是為「普通藥典品項」設計的，但你的產品可能有：(1) 供應商特有的雜質謙 profile；(2) 獨特的賦形劑組合；(3) 容器萃取物。就像「通用型安全帶」設計是為普通體型，但對特殊體型的人可能需要額外確認。
blocks.en: The chapter uses specificity as an example to stress its importance. USP procedures are designed for "typical compendial articles," but your product may have: (1) a supplier-specific impurity profile; (2) a unique combination of excipients; (3) container extractables. It is like a "universal seat belt" designed for a typical body size: people with unusual body sizes may need additional confirmation.

blocks.zh: 驗證範疇的分級思路 Tiered Verification Approach
blocks.en: Tiered Verification Approach

blocks.zh:
基礎藥典試驗（通常不需驗證）：
  - 乾燥失重（Loss on Drying）
  - 灼燒殘渣（Residue on Ignition）
  - 酸值（Acid Value）
  - pH測定
  例外：首次用於新品項時，考慮樣品前處理差異

需要驗證的方向（按風險排序）：
  1. 特異性（Specificity）← 最優先
     → 系統適用性（分離度符合要求？）
     → 強制降解干擾確認
  2. 基質效應（Matrix Effects）
     → 加標回收率（Spike Recovery）
  3. 精確性（Precision）
     → 在實際基質下的重現性
  4. 樣品/標準品穩定性（>24小時）
     → 用戶責任，<1226>明確要求
blocks.en:
Basic compendial tests (usually no verification needed):
  - Loss on Drying
  - Residue on Ignition
  - Acid Value
  - pH determination
  Exception: when first used for a new article, consider differences in sample preparation

Areas requiring verification (ranked by risk):
  1. Specificity ← highest priority
     → System suitability (is the required resolution met?)
     → Confirmation of no interference from forced degradation
  2. Matrix Effects
     → Spike Recovery
  3. Precision
     → Reproducibility in the actual matrix
  4. Sample/standard stability (>24 hours)
     → User responsibility, explicitly required by <1226>

blocks.zh: >24小時穩定性的特別要求 Key Note: >24h Stability
blocks.en: Key Note: >24h Stability

blocks.zh: USP <1226> 明確規定（2019年修訂新增）：使用者的責任包括在驗證過程中展示標準品和樣品製備液在整個分析程序期間（超過24小時）的長期穩定性和儲存條件。
blocks.en: USP <1226> explicitly states (added in the 2019 revision) that the user's responsibility includes demonstrating, during verification, the long-term stability and storage conditions of the standard and sample preparations over the entire analytical procedure (more than 24 hours).

blocks.zh: 這在實務上意味著：若你的HPLC分析序列跨越多天（如大批量樣品），必須證明樣品溶液在此期間穩定，並設定明確的儲存條件（溫度、避光等）。
blocks.en: In practice, this means that if your HPLC analytical sequence spans several days (for example, a large batch of samples), you must show that the sample solutions remain stable over that period and define clear storage conditions (temperature, protection from light, etc.).

blocks.zh: 驗證計畫設計練習 Verification Plan Design Exercise
blocks.en: Verification Plan Design Exercise

blocks.zh: 場景：你的CDMO首次對一個含5種賦形劑的口服固體製劑，使用USP HPLC方法進行含量測定。請規劃驗證方案：
blocks.en: Scenario: Your CDMO is using a USP HPLC method to assay an oral solid dosage form containing 5 excipients for the first time. Plan the verification:

blocks.zh: 哪些分析性能特性需要評估？（至少列出3項並說明理由）
blocks.en: Which analytical performance characteristics need to be evaluated? (List at least 3 and explain why.)

blocks.zh: 特異性如何評估？（至少列出2種方法）
blocks.en: How would you evaluate specificity? (List at least 2 approaches.)

blocks.zh: 基質效應如何評估？需要什麼對照實驗？
blocks.en: How would you evaluate matrix effects? What control experiments are needed?

blocks.zh: 樣品溶液穩定性如何設計實驗？設定什麼時間點？
blocks.en: How would you design the sample solution stability study? What time points would you set?

blocks.zh: 實務應用：驗證 vs. 確效文件化差異 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application: Documentation Differences Between Verification and Validation

blocks.zh: 驗證報告（Verification Report）的典型要素：
blocks.en: Typical elements of a verification report:

blocks.zh: 目的和範疇（針對特定產品和USP方法）
blocks.en: Purpose and scope (for the specific product and USP procedure)

blocks.zh: 評估的分析性能特性及其選擇理由
blocks.en: Analytical performance characteristics evaluated, and the rationale for selecting them

blocks.zh: 各特性的接受標準（可引用<1225> Category要求）
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria for each characteristic (may refer to the <1225> category requirements)

blocks.zh: 實驗數據（原始數據 + 計算結果）
blocks.en: Experimental data (raw data + calculated results)

blocks.zh: 系統適用性結果
blocks.en: System suitability results

blocks.zh: 特異性評估結果（系統適用性分離度、加標干擾）
blocks.en: Specificity evaluation results (system suitability resolution, spiked interference)

blocks.zh: 樣品/標準品穩定性數據
blocks.en: Sample/standard stability data

blocks.zh: 結論（方法是否適合在本實驗室用於本產品）
blocks.en: Conclusion (whether the procedure is suitable for use in this laboratory for this product)

blocks.zh: 在CDMO環境中，驗證報告通常作為方法轉移報告（Method Transfer Report）的一部分，或作為獨立的「Methods Verification Report」提交客戶和監管部門。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, the verification report is usually included as part of the Method Transfer Report, or issued as a standalone "Methods Verification Report" to the client and regulatory authorities.

blocks.zh: 關係整合 Relationship: <1225> Validation vs. <1226> Verification
blocks.en: Relationship: <1225> Validation vs. <1226> Verification

blocks.zh: 兩章節的協同作用比喻
blocks.en: How the Two Chapters Work Together: An Analogy

blocks.zh: <1225>是「汽車設計規範」——告訴你一輛好車應該滿足哪些標準（剎車距離、油耗、碰撞安全）；<1226>是「車主手冊」——告訴你這輛車在你的使用場景下（你的路況、你的駕駛習慣）是否正常工作。兩者用同樣的評估語言，但目的和深度不同。
blocks.en: <1225> is the "car design specification": it tells you which standards a good car should meet (braking distance, fuel consumption, crash safety). <1226> is the "owner's manual": it tells you whether this car works properly in your situation (your roads, your driving habits). Both use the same evaluation language, but their purpose and depth differ.

blocks.zh: 常見混淆點澄清 Common Confusions Clarified
blocks.en: Common Confusions Clarified

blocks.zh: 「驗證」不是「確效」的縮減版——驗證是針對特定基質的適用性確認，不是草率做幾個確效實驗
blocks.en: "Verification" is not a scaled-down version of "validation": verification is confirmation of suitability for a specific matrix, not a hasty handful of validation experiments

blocks.zh: 驗證不等於方法轉移——方法轉移（Method Transfer）可能包含驗證，但也可能包含更多（如設備比較、分析師培訓）
blocks.en: Verification is not the same as method transfer: method transfer may include verification, but may also include more (such as equipment comparison and analyst training)

blocks.zh: 微生物方法不適用本章——請參考各自的方法適用性試驗（Method Suitability Test）
blocks.en: Microbiological procedures are outside the scope of this chapter: refer to the respective Method Suitability Test

blocks.zh: 基礎試驗通常豁免驗證——但首次用於新品項時要考慮樣品前處理的差異
blocks.en: Basic tests are usually exempt from verification: but when first used for a new article, consider differences in sample preparation

blocks.zh: 綜合練習 Comprehensive Practice
blocks.en: Comprehensive Practice

blocks.zh: 你負責QC實驗室首次引入USP HPLC原料藥含量測定方法，制定一份驗證計畫，說明：(a) 需要評估哪些分析性能特性；(b) 各特性的接受標準；(c) 實驗設計要點。
blocks.en: You are responsible for introducing a USP HPLC drug substance assay in the QC laboratory for the first time. Draw up a verification plan that describes: (a) which analytical performance characteristics need to be evaluated; (b) the acceptance criteria for each; (c) the key points of the experimental design.

blocks.zh: 客戶提供的原料藥含有4種未知雜質（非USP藥典方法原設計覆蓋的），如何在驗證中處理這個問題？是做驗證還是必須做確效？
blocks.en: The drug substance supplied by the client contains 4 unknown impurities (not covered by the original design of the USP procedure). How should this be handled in verification? Is verification sufficient, or must validation be performed?

blocks.zh: <1226>要求「使用者負責證明>24小時穩定性」，請設計一個簡單的穩定性評估實驗（說明取樣時間點和接受標準）。
blocks.en: <1226> requires that "the user is responsible for demonstrating stability beyond 24 hours." Design a simple stability evaluation experiment (state the sampling time points and acceptance criteria).

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 核心定位：<1226>為藥廠使用USP方法提供指引——不是要重複確效，而是要確認「適用性」
blocks.en: Core positioning: <1226> provides guidance for manufacturers using USP procedures; the aim is not to repeat validation but to confirm "suitability"

blocks.zh: 法規依據：21 CFR 211.194(a)(2)——「所有測試方法的適用性應在實際使用條件下驗證」
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: 21 CFR 211.194(a)(2): "the suitability of all testing methods used shall be verified under actual conditions of use"

blocks.zh: 範疇限制：不適用於微生物方法（另有各章規定）；不適用於回顧性應用
blocks.en: Scope limits: does not apply to microbiological procedures (covered in their own chapters); does not apply to retrospective application

blocks.zh: 基本原則：只評估適當的分析性能特性，不需要全套<1225>確效；由複雜度和風險決定範疇
blocks.en: Basic principle: evaluate only the appropriate analytical performance characteristics; the full <1225> validation is not required; complexity and risk determine the scope

blocks.zh: 最重要的特性：特異性——必須確認方法在你的基質條件下無干擾
blocks.en: Most important characteristic: specificity: you must confirm that the procedure is free from interference in your matrix

blocks.zh: 基質效應評估：賦形劑、合成路線相關雜質、容器萃取物都可能干擾
blocks.en: Matrix effect evaluation: excipients, synthesis-route-related impurities and container extractables may all cause interference

blocks.zh: 2019新增要求：使用者負責展示>24小時的樣品和標準品穩定性
blocks.en: New requirement in 2019: the user is responsible for demonstrating sample and standard stability beyond 24 hours

blocks.zh: 豁免項目：基礎試驗（乾燥失重、pH等）通常不需驗證；首次用於新品項除外
blocks.en: Exempt items: basic tests (loss on drying, pH, etc.) usually do not need verification, except when first used for a new article

blocks.zh: 驗證失敗處理：諮詢USP → 若仍不適用 → 開發替代方法 → 可提交USP修訂
blocks.en: Handling a failed verification: consult USP → if the procedure is still unsuitable → develop an alternative procedure → a proposed revision can be submitted to USP

blocks.zh: 與<1225>關係：使用相同的分析性能特性框架，但驗證是風險導向的子集應用
blocks.en: Relationship with <1225>: uses the same framework of analytical performance characteristics, but verification is a risk-based subset application
